info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Discounts-v2-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Discounts Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of available utility billing discounts. This endpoint serves as a resource for utility providers, financial institutions, and other stakeholders looking to enhance their understanding of discount offerings available to customers. By retrieving detailed discount information, businesses can improve customer engagement and tailor their services effectively. Typical use cases include generating reports, informing customer service representatives, and aiding marketing strategies focused on discount promotion.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details about available billing discounts. It provides essential information that can help in applying discounts effectively during the billing process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discount information for billing purposes. It should include all necessary parameters to identify the billing entity and the applicable discounts.
